properties.name: BLR/SUJ/001
properties.site-address: Land to the south of Chapel Gate, Sutton St James
properties.notes: Redevelopment of the site would provide an opportunity to enhance the setting of the Grade II listed Church of St James and Grade II* listed Tower to the Church of St James. A significant landscaping component at the Chapel Gate frontage would aid this. The South East Lincolnshire Strategic Housing Land Availability Assessment (SHLAA) (April 2017) identifies that there is a need to improve the water and foul sewerage network. SHLAA ref no: Suj007. The site is a proposed housing allocation in the South East Lincolnshire Local Plan (2011-2036): Publication Version (March 2017).. http://www.southeastlincslocalplan.org/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Moulton-map-and-report.pdf
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
